Our device uses UFS 4.1 (JESD220G) with the Permanent Bootable Logical Unit feature. A factory-reset attempt after a botched OTA leaves the device unable to re-partition:

  ufs: bConfigDescrLock=0xff, bBootLunEn=0xff
  fastboot: FAILED (remote: 'bootable LU is permanently locked')

Is there any software recovery path? What is the JEDEC-specified intent of this feature, why does it differ from UFS 4.0, and what factory provisioning flow error leads to premature lock? What should our field-return policy be for devices in this state?
